snippet.title: Warcraft 2: Beyond the Dark Portal - Human Campaign Gameplay - Mission 2
snippet.description:
Human Campaign (Expansion): Mission 2

Note: Didn't expect mission 2 to be so hard. In retrospect, I should probably have attacked and wiped out black with the initial force (the dwarves can take down one of the towers in the middle which wasn't guarded by walls like the red ones and the ballista and knights could make short work of the other one).
